pla-01.prompt: Use case: scientific-educational. Asset: AAC vocabulary image for the exact Catalan concept BON NADAL. Create ONE image. Style: Flat 2D educational illustration, solid colors, simple clear outlines, no photographic texture or 3D rendering. Subject: Stable symbolic Christmas greeting: two full-body fully clothed people facing each other, one smiling and raising an open hand in greeting while the other offers a small wrapped present; a small decorated Christmas tree with plain colored balls and a star beside them. Friendly seasonal greeting, not speech or writing. No text, letters, numerals, speech bubbles, logos or decorative lettering. Composition: pure white background, isolated complete subject or compact necessary scene only, keep the entire subject within the central 75 percent of the canvas, leaving a generous uninterrupted white margin on EVERY side including above heads and below feet or wheels. All objects and people fully inside frame, natural anatomy and hands. No text, letters, numerals, names, labels, branding, logos, watermarks or pseudowriting anywhere, including packaging, books, clothing or hardware. No frame, no collage. The vocabulary label is shown outside the image by the app.
pla-01.review: Bon Nadal: salutació i regal amb arbre nadalenc, figures completes i contorn clar; símbol únic sense text.
